title: Rosalind and the Portrait
author: Ivo Montrose
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
